title: SaaS Health Overview
description: MRR, paying customers, signups and churn, with plan and channel breakdowns. MRR history is reconstructed from signup and churn dates, using each customer's current MRR value.

panels.title: Current MRR
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT greatest(max(signup_date), max(churned_at)) AS d FROM saas)
SELECT
  sum(mrr) FILTER (WHERE signup_date <= d AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at > d)) AS mrr,
  sum(mrr) FILTER (WHERE signup_date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS prev_mrr
FROM saas, a

panels.title: Paying customers
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT greatest(max(signup_date), max(churned_at)) AS d FROM saas)
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0 AND signup_date <= d AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at > d)) AS paying,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0 AND signup_date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS prev_paying
FROM saas, a

panels.title: Signups (30d)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT greatest(max(signup_date), max(churned_at)) AS d FROM saas)
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND signup_date <= d) AS signups,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY AND signup_date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS prev_signups
FROM saas, a

panels.title: Churn rate (30d)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT greatest(max(signup_date), max(churned_at)) AS d FROM saas)
SELECT
  1.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND churned_at > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND churned_at <= d)
    / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY)), 0) AS churn_rate,
  1.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date <= d - INTERVAL 60 DAY AND churned_at > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY AND churned_at <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date <= d - INTERVAL 60 DAY AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY)), 0) AS prev_churn_rate
FROM saas, a

panels.title: MRR by plan (month-end)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT greatest(max(signup_date), max(churned_at)) AS d FROM saas
),
m AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(g AS DATE) AS month,
    least(CAST(g AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY, (SELECT d FROM a)) AS snap
  FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(date_trunc('month', min(signup_date)), date_trunc('month', max(signup_date)), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS g FROM saas)
)
SELECT
  m.month AS month,
  s.plan AS plan,
  sum(s.mrr) AS mrr
FROM m
JOIN saas s
  ON s.signup_date <= m.snap
  AND (s.churned_at IS NULL OR s.churned_at > m.snap)
WHERE s.plan <> 'free'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly signups by plan
panels.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('week', signup_date) AS week,
  plan,
  count(*) AS signups
FROM saas
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly churn rate by plan
panels.sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT CAST(g AS DATE) AS month
  FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(date_trunc('month', min(signup_date)), date_trunc('month', max(signup_date)), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS g FROM saas)
)
SELECT
  m.month AS month,
  s.plan AS plan,
  1.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.churned_at < m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH) / count(*) AS churn_rate
FROM m
JOIN saas s
  ON s.signup_date < m.month
  AND (s.churned_at IS NULL OR s.churned_at >= m.month)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Signups by channel
panels.sql:
SELECT
  channel,
  count(*) AS signups
FROM saas
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY signups DESC

panels.title: Top accounts by MRR
panels.sql:
SELECT
  company,
  plan,
  seats,
  country,
  channel,
  signup_date,
  mrr
FROM saas
WHERE churned_at IS NULL
ORDER BY mrr DESC, seats DESC
LIMIT 20
